title: Page 63
transc:
Wherry pike lie in gridle papers that Brooks more
have sailed from that city ---- will repeat Paxton
McIntosh panther Lantern returns I have just examined violet
radical whose statement made in Bard was sent you
last night he evidently believes what he says Behead
HW Halleck
Chf of Staff


9 PM
Horner No 1  Wash. May 2. 1864. 
NY 
Rosalie for paradise H. S. Ol - cott Frog 
---- Letter recd Do not proceed against anyone
in Frog Yard ---- You are Commissioned to
investigate only not to prosecute ---- That will
be done by the Burton upon all the
facts which you are able to collect ----
It was only today that Solicitor Whiting gave
his opinion upon certain points ---- When you
have finished your evidence in any case wick
it ready for examination <deletion>G</deletion> Sig Fox Asst buxton
